Extension per unit original length, ε = x/L; no unit.
Tensile stress ÷ tensile strain (within the limit of proportionality), in Pa.

front: Young modulus in terms of measured quantities
Young modulus of steel (order of magnitude)

back: The maximum stress a material can withstand before breaking.
Ductile: large plastic region before breaking (copper). Brittle: breaks at the end of the elastic region (glass).
It cancels the effects of temperature change and sagging of the support on the measured extension.

front: Largest uncertainty in the wire experiment
back: The diameter, because it is small and is squared in the area (its percentage uncertainty counts twice).
